semiconductor_relevance: High — Top Seiko specializes in precision machining of materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing, including ceramics and quartz glass.
summary: Top Seiko provides micron-order precision machining services for ceramics, high-melting-point metals, and quartz glass, essential for semiconductor applications. They offer custom tooling and have developed joining technologies that enhance product performance and reliability.
capabilities: Precision machining of ceramics and quartz glass
Diffusion bonding technology for joining materials
Custom tool design for specific machining requirements
